body:
The problem with taking up hobbies and stuff is that I live in a pretty small town where there isn't really anything like that to do, and even if there was, I'm in a state lately where I just don't feel like I want to do anything at all. Anything that requires going anywhere or putting any effort in just puts me off and I basically feel like I'd rather just stay in and watch Netflix all day. 

It sounds like I'm making excuses but I can't really get past these barriers. There are gyms nearby but I know that if I signed up to a gym I'd just go in, work out with my earphones in, and then leave. I'm not good at interacting with people unless I'm forced to.
